Banh Mi Bliss……
May 2026 • Couples
We visited Grandma Lu at their Pham Ngu Lau outlet. It’s very small, but the young lady who served us was fantastic, and the Banh Mi and Caphe Sua Da was also superb……….such fantastic value for money and the Banh Mi was just superb………It is in a great area for travellers with food everywhere…….we will definitely be regulars at this Grandma Lu outlet
Insider tip:
This outlet is in a very busy fun part of D1 in HCMC, Pham Ngu Lau……great streets to walk
